title: Schneider receives Certified Cold Carrier designation, demonstrating industry leadership in dedicated refrigerated shipping
summary: Certification from the Global Cold Chain Alliance underscores company’s commitment to safe and sanitary food transport Transporting refrigerated goods requires coordination, specialized expertise and best-in-class equipment. As a reliable carrier, Schneider is focused on the precise timing, execution and on-time service that are critical given the regulatory requirements surrounding consumer-grade fresh food. Reinforcing its expertise in dedicated refrigerated shipping, Schneider National, Inc. (NYSE: SNDR), a premier multimodal provider of transportation, intermodal and logistics services, is proud to announce it has obtained the Certified Cold Carrier designation from the Global Cold Chain Alliance.
